newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares rise but Unibanka trade wanes.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares rise but Unibanka trade wanes.

text.p: Latvian stock prices rose during the second trading session of 1997 on Friday while market leader Unibanka saw its turnover almost halved.
Total turnover rose to 57,697 as most shares edged up.
But Unibanka's turnover fell to 28,800 lats against trade of 43,945 lats on January 2. Its share price rose five santimes to 2.40 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet of the official list had turnover of 14,077 lats and its price rose by one santime to one lats.
On the secondary list Daugavpils chain maker was the most traded with shares worth 2,300 lats changing hands at unchanged 1.13 lats.
Elsewhere on the secondary market several other shares were well-traded.
Mangali Shipyard traded 1,525 lats and fell to 0.45 santimes from 0.52 and Jekabpils Sugar had volume of 1,130 lats as it rose four santimes to 0.36 santimes.
